seo_title: About JS Neurominds | Psychiatry & Mental Health Clinic, Chandragiri, Tirupati
seo_description: About JS Neurominds and Diagnostic Center — a psychiatry and mental health clinic in Chandragiri, Tirupati, led by Dr. Jayapriya T, MD. Private, respectful, evidence-based care for all ages.
title: Care rooted in compassion
lede: JS Neurominds and Diagnostic Center is a psychiatry and mental health clinic in Chandragiri, Tirupati, offering evidence-based care for individuals and families across all ages.
approach_text: We believe mental health care should be private, respectful, and free of judgement. Every person who walks through our doors is met with warmth and a personalised plan.
offer_text: Consultations for adults, children, and seniors; online consultation; de-addiction support; counselling and psychotherapy; and convenient diagnostic services with home sample collection.
